data.goal: Build a two-step interaction analysis around EGFR, ERBB2 and MET using HPA consensus interactions and Ensembl IDs. Treat edges as undirected, remove self-edges, deduplicate edges and restrict endpoints to genes in the atlas master table. Define the first layer as the union of the seeds' neighbours excluding all three seeds; define the second layer as nodes reached from the first layer excluding seeds and the entire first layer. Report both layer sizes, each seed's neighbour count before excludin…

items.text: Get HPA master table (gene universe) and HPA consensus interactions; build undirected, deduplicated, self-edge-free network restricted to master-table genes

Compute first layer (union of seed neighbours minus seeds) and second layer (neighbours of first layer minus seeds and first layer); report layer sizes, per-seed neighbour counts, pairwise shared-neighbour counts
For each second-layer gene, count distinct first-layer intermediaries connecting it to each seed (EGFR, ERBB2, MET)

Rank top 12 second-layer genes by sum of three intermediary counts (ties by Ensembl ID); report the three counts, seeds reached, main subcellular locations, FDA drug-target status, validated favourable/unfavourable TCGA cohort counts
Shared-neighbour heatmap (pairwise shared neighbours among the three seeds)
Seed-by-second-layer path-count heatmap (top second-layer genes × seeds, cell = intermediary count)
Ranked bar chart of top 12 genes by total intermediary count
Interpretation: summary of network structure, key findings, limitations

limitations: The HPA consensus interaction set is a curated subset of known protein–protein interactions; absence of an edge does not imply absence of a biological interaction.
All 16 genes tied at total intermediary count = 3 were truncated to 12 by Ensembl ID; the 4 excluded genes (LCK, CD2AP, SPRR2A, PECAM1) have identical network metrics to the 12 reported.

The 'recorded' metric for TCGA prognostic counts reflects the number of cancer cohorts with a non-empty validated prognostic entry, not the number of patients or the statistical strength of the association.
Subcellular location is reported as the atlas's 'Main location' field, which may list multiple compartments separated by semicolons; it is not a single definitive location.
The network is built on undirected edges; directionality of signalling (e.g., receptor → adaptor) is not captured.

items.text: Get HPA master table (gene universe) and HPA consensus interactions; build undirected, deduplicated, self-edge-free network restricted to master-table genes

Compute first layer (union of seed neighbours minus seeds) and second layer (neighbours of first layer minus seeds and first layer); report layer sizes, per-seed neighbour counts, pairwise shared-neighbour counts
For each second-layer gene, count distinct first-layer intermediaries connecting it to each seed (EGFR, ERBB2, MET)

Rank top 12 second-layer genes by sum of three intermediary counts (ties by Ensembl ID); report the three counts, seeds reached, main subcellular locations, FDA drug-target status, validated favourable/unfavourable TCGA cohort counts
Shared-neighbour heatmap (pairwise shared neighbours among the three seeds)
Seed-by-second-layer path-count heatmap (top second-layer genes × seeds, cell = intermediary count)
Ranked bar chart of top 12 genes by total intermediary count
Interpretation: summary of network structure, key findings, limitations
